site.anchor: a segunda fase (arts. 61 a 67)

source.quote: Art. 65 - São circunstâncias que sempre atenuam a pena:

readings.description: The second-phase result is floored at the cominated minimum: atenuantes reduce towards it but not past it; symmetrically, agravantes stop at the maximum.
'Sempre atenuam' means always: an atenuante may take the penalty below the cominated minimum, which binds only the pena-base.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 231 STJ holds the atenuante cannot take the penalty below the legal minimum.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 231 STJ (M-sweep-a-09). The second phase is a range; its floor is the cominated minimum and its ceiling the maximum, the ceiling being the same reading applied to the agravantes.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 231: "A incidência da circunstância atenuante não pode conduzir à redução da pena abaixo do mínimo legal."

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: `a segunda fase (arts. 61 a 67)` with a pena-base at the minimum and an atenuante gives 2 to 2 years
notes: The ceiling for the agravantes is the same reading in mirror; no authority for it was fetched.

site.anchor: a valoração dos antecedentes é admissível

source.quote: Art. 61 - São circunstâncias que sempre agravam a pena, quando não constituem ou qualificam o crime:

readings.description: No: a conviction that makes the agent reincidente is weighed only in the second phase; it cannot also raise the pena-base. Where the agent has two such convictions, one may be the record and the other the reincidência.
Yes: art. 59 and art. 61 are independent and each may take the same conviction into account.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 241 STJ forbids it.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 241 STJ (M-sweep-a-10). Encoded per conviction: the valuation of the record is inadmissible when every conviction that generates reincidência was weighed as a bad record, since art. 61 makes the agravante apply "sempre".

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 241: "A reincidência penal não pode ser considerada como circunstância agravante e, simultaneamente, como circunstância judicial."

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: `admite-se valorar como antecedentes` "processo 1" with that conviction alone (FALSE) and "processo 9" beside "processo 1" (TRUE)
notes: That one of two reincidência-generating convictions may be the record and the other the agravante is the STJ practice as g1b understands it; no authority for that part was fetched.

site.anchor: a valoração dos antecedentes é admissível

source.quote: Art. 59 - O juiz, atendendo à culpabilidade, aos antecedentes, à conduta social, à personalidade do agente, aos motivos, às circunstâncias e conseqüências do crime, bem como ao comportamento da vítima, estabelecerá, conforme seja necessário e suficiente para reprovação e prevenção do crime:

readings.description: Only final convictions (final by the day of the sentence) count; there is no time limit on them; pending inquiries and prosecutions never count.
Art. 64, I's five-year purge applies to antecedentes by analogy.
readings.rejection_rationale: RE 593.818/SC: the five-year period does not apply to maus antecedentes.

readings.description: Pending inquiries and prosecutions are part of the agent's antecedentes.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 444 STJ forbids it.

taken.rationale: Settled by RE 593.818/SC (M-sweep-a-12) and Súmula 444 STJ (M-sweep-a-11). The rule never consults art. 64 for the record, refuses pending inquiries, and accepts only convictions final by the sentence.

settled_by.citation: RE 593.818/SC: "Não se aplica ao reconhecimento dos maus antecedentes o prazo quinquenal de prescrição da reincidência, previsto no art. 64, I, do Código Penal."

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: a conviction served in 2015 (purged from reincidência) admitted as a record; "processo 12", final after the sentence, refused; pending inquiries refused
notes: M-sweep-a-13 (Súmula 636 STJ, the criminal-record sheet suffices as proof) is a rule of proof; the encoding takes the convictions as input.

interpretation_field: Leituras do concurso.o aumento segue a escala da Súmula 659 STJ

site.anchor: o aumento do crime continuado (art. 71)

source.quote: aplica-se-lhe a pena de um só dos crimes, se idênticas, ou a mais grave, se diversas, aumentada, em qualquer caso, de um sexto a dois terços.

readings.description: The Code gives a range; the fraction within it is the judge's, to be reasoned.
The fraction follows the number of offences: 1/6 for two, 1/5 for three, 1/4 for four, 1/3 for five, 1/2 for six, 2/3 for seven or more.

taken.rationale: Súmula 659 STJ (M-sweep-a-14) states the fraction the STJ requires; the Code's range stays the legal bound and runs as the other reading. The field is a BOOLEAN with TYPICALLY TRUE (TRUE is escalaPorNumeroDeCrimes, FALSE is faixaDoJuiz), and the named value `a leitura da Súmula 659 STJ` carries the same default.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 659: "A fração de aumento em razão da prática de crime continuado deve ser fixada de acordo com o número de delitos cometidos, aplicando-se 1/6 pela prática de duas infrações, 1/5 para três, 1/4 para quatro, 1/3 para cinco, 1/2 para seis e 2/3 para sete ou mais infrações."

witnesses: cp-g1b-concurso-de-crimes-testes.l4: three crimes of two years — 28.8 months under escalaPorNumeroDeCrimes, 28 to 40 months under faixaDoJuiz
notes: The field is a BOOLEAN, so the reading ids are not L4 constructors: escalaPorNumeroDeCrimes is TRUE and faixaDoJuiz is FALSE. It was first an enum with those two constructors; this binary rejects a TYPICALLY whose value is a constructor of one's own enum (notes/cp-g1b-sondas/cp-g1b-sonda-typically-enum.l4), so at the conductor's request (2026-09-30) it became a BOOLEAN, on which TYPICALLY is accepted.
A gloss on its own line below a TYPICALLY field is silently lost (cp-g1b-sonda-typically-boolean.l4); the field puts it between its name and its type (cp-g1b-sonda-typically-boolean-split.l4).

site.anchor: a pena que regula a prescrição do crime continuado (Súmula 497 STF)

source.quote: Art. 119 - No caso de concurso de crimes, a extinção da punibilidade incidirá sobre a pena de cada um, isoladamente.

readings.description: Prescription is governed by the penalty imposed for the crime, not counting the continuation increase.
Art. 71 treats the continued crimes as one, so the increased penalty is the one art. 110 measures.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 497 STF.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 497 STF (M-sweep-a-15). g1b exposes the penalty before the increase; the prescription itself is g1c's (arts. 109 to 119).

settled_by.citation: Súmula 497: "QUANDO SE TRATAR DE CRIME CONTINUADO, A PRESCRIÇÃO REGULA-SE PELA PENA IMPOSTA NA SENTENÇA, NÃO SE COMPUTANDO O ACRÉSCIMO DECORRENTE DA CONTINUAÇÃO."

witnesses: cp-g1b-concurso-de-crimes-testes.l4: `a pena que regula a prescrição do crime continuado (Súmula 497 STF)` gives two years where the continued penalty is more
notes: Created by g1b because art. 71 is the lowest-numbered provision; g1c (arts. 109–119) cross-refers to it and dropped its own copy (2026-09-30).
A second site, g1c's: cp-g1c-prescricao.l4, `a pena que regula a prescrição no crime continuado (Súmula 497 STF)` (art. 119).

site.anchor: a pena considerada para os benefícios (art. 75; Súmula 715 STF)

source.quote: § 1º Quando o agente for condenado a penas privativas de liberdade cuja soma seja superior a 40 (quarenta) anos, devem elas ser unificadas para atender ao limite máximo deste artigo.

readings.description: The ceiling limits time served; fractions for benefits are computed on the total penalty imposed.
The unified penalty replaces the total for every purpose, including the fractions of art. 83.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 715 STF.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 715 STF (M-sweep-a-20), whose "trinta anos" is the pre-2020 ceiling; its rule is not tied to the number.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 715: "A PENA UNIFICADA PARA ATENDER AO LIMITE DE TRINTA ANOS DE CUMPRIMENTO, DETERMINADO PELO ART. 75 DO CÓDIGO PENAL, NÃO É CONSIDERADA PARA A CONCESSÃO DE OUTROS BENEFÍCIOS, COMO O LIVRAMENTO CONDICIONAL OU REGIME MAIS FAVORÁVEL DE EXECUÇÃO."

witnesses: cp-g1b-concurso-de-crimes-testes.l4: thirty and fifteen years — unified to 40, benefits on 45
notes: Created by g1b because art. 75 is the lowest-numbered provision; g1c cross-refers to it at art. 84, whose fractions it computes on the sum of the penalties, never on art. 75's ceiling (message from g1c, 2026-09-30).

delegated_field: Sentença.fundamentação concreta e idônea para regime mais gravoso

site.anchor: os regimes iniciais admissíveis (art. 33, §§ 2º e 3º)

source.quote: § 3º - A determinação do regime inicial de cumprimento da pena far-se-á com observância dos critérios previstos no art. 59 deste Código.

readings.description: A regime harsher than the penalty permits only on an idoneous, concrete reason from the art. 59 circumstances; the abstract gravity of the offence is never enough.
Art. 33, § 3º's reference to art. 59 lets the judge weigh the offence's gravity as such.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmulas 718 and 719 STF, 440 STJ.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmulas 718 and 719 STF and 440 STJ (M-sweep-a-21, M-sweep-a-22). The encoding computes the regime the penalty permits and admits a harsher one only where the sentence records a concrete, proper ground; whether a reason is idoneous is the judge's and cannot be computed.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 718: "A OPINIÃO DO JULGADOR SOBRE A GRAVIDADE EM ABSTRATO DO CRIME NÃO CONSTITUI MOTIVAÇÃO IDÔNEA PARA A IMPOSIÇÃO DE REGIME MAIS SEVERO DO QUE O PERMITIDO SEGUNDO A PENA APLICADA."

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: four years of reclusão to a first offender — aberto alone without the ground, aberto to fechado with it

site.anchor: o regime inicial mais brando que a pena permite (art. 33, § 2º)

source.quote: b) o condenado não reincidente, cuja pena seja superior a 4 (quatro) anos e não exceda a 8 (oito), poderá, desde o princípio, cumpri-la em regime semi-aberto;

readings.description: At four years or less, the semi-aberto is admissible if the art. 59 circumstances are favourable; otherwise, and above four years, the harshest regime the species allows (for detenção, the semi-aberto).
Every reincidente starts in fechado: § 2º grants the milder regimes only to the não reincidente.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 269 STJ admits the semi-aberto at four years or less.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 269 STJ (M-sweep-a-23) for four years or less; above that the text's silence leaves the harshest regime the species allows, and art. 33's caput keeps detenção from starting closed (F-g1b-01).

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 269: "É admissível a adoção do regime prisional semi-aberto aos reincidentes condenados a pena igual ou inferior a quatro anos se favoráveis as circunstâncias judiciais."

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: a reincidente with four years — semi-aberto with favourable circumstances, fechado without

site.anchor: a confissão parcial ou qualificada atenua (art. 65, III, d)

source.quote: d) confessado espontaneamente, perante a autoridade, a autoria do crime;

readings.description: Any spontaneous confession attenuates, whether or not the judge relied on it; a partial or qualified confession attenuates in a smaller proportion.
The confession attenuates only if used to form the judge's conviction, and a qualified confession does not attenuate.

citations.cite: STJ, Súmulas 545 and 630 in their wording before 10/09/2025

readings.rejection_rationale: Both súmulas were revised on 10/09/2025.

taken.rationale: Settled by the revised Súmulas 545 and 630 STJ (M-sweep-a-24, M-sweep-a-25). A full and a partial or qualified confession are two atenuantes, so the judge can weigh the second less; the proportion is the judge's.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção (tema repetitivo 1194)
settled_by.citation: Súmula 545 (revised): "A confissão do autor possibilita a atenuação da pena prevista no art. 65, III, d, do Código Penal, independentemente de ser utilizada na formação do convencimento do julgador."

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a partial confession gives `a confissão parcial ou qualificada (art. 65, III, d)`; with a full one, only the full

site.anchor: o regime inicial mais gravoso da espécie (art. 33, caput)

source.quote: A de detenção, em regime semi-aberto, ou aberto, salvo necessidade de transferência a regime fechado.

citations.cite: CP art. 33, § 2º, a — "o condenado a pena superior a 8 (oito) anos deverá começar a cumpri-la em regime fechado"

readings.description: Detenção starts in the semi-aberto or aberto; the closed regime is reached only by transfer, so a detenção over eight years starts in the semi-aberto.
§ 2º, a speaks of any penalty over eight years, so a detenção over eight years starts closed.
readings.rejection_rationale: The caput says what regimes detenção is served in and allows the closed one only by transfer; § 2º applies "observados" the species. Reading a as reaching detenção would make the caput's "salvo necessidade de transferência" idle.

taken.rationale: The caput states the regimes of each species; § 2º orders the start within them.

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: detenção of nine years gives semi-aberto only
notes: No authority fetched; g1b believes this is also the courts' reading.

site.anchor: os regimes iniciais admissíveis (art. 33, §§ 2º e 3º)

source.quote: a) o condenado a pena superior a 8 (oito) anos deverá começar a cumpri-la em regime fechado;

readings.description: "pena" is the penalty applied in the sentence.
"pena" is the maximum the preceito prescribes.
readings.rejection_rationale: § 2º speaks of "o condenado a pena", the convict's penalty, and art. 59, III fixes the regime in the sentence after the quantity (II).

taken.rationale: The regime is fixed in the sentence after the quantity; in concurso, the sum the execution unifies is the Lei de Execução Penal's (art. 111), outside the source.

site.anchor: as circunstâncias judiciais são favoráveis

source.quote: § 3º - A determinação do regime inicial de cumprimento da pena far-se-á com observância dos critérios previstos no art. 59 deste Código.

citations.cite: STJ, Súmula 269 — "se favoráveis as circunstâncias judiciais"

readings.description: The circumstances are favourable when none of the eight was valued against the accused; neutral ones do not count against.
Every one of the eight must be valued favourable.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 59's circumstances are often not valued either way; requiring all to be positively favourable would make the súmula almost never apply.

taken.rationale: The judge values each circumstance favourable, neutral or unfavourable; only an unfavourable one weighs against.

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: `circunstâncias neutras` favourable; one unfavourable (the record) not
notes: The three-valued valuation (favorável, neutra, desfavorável) is the judge's vocabulary for art. 59, not an epistemic status.

site.anchor: o tempo de custódia do período (art. 42)

source.quote: Art. 42 - Computam-se, na pena privativa de liberdade e na medida de segurança, o tempo de prisão provisória, no Brasil ou no estrangeiro, o de prisão administrativa e o de internação em qualquer dos estabelecimentos referidos no artigo anterior.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — "O dia do começo inclui-se no cômputo do prazo. Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum."

readings.description: Each period is credited as the whole calendar months it covers from its first day, plus the days left over, the first and the last day counting.
Each period is its days in custody, first and last included, at a thirtieth of a month per day.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 10 counts months on the common calendar; the thirty-day month is the dosimetry's convention for fractions of a penalty (F-g0-03), not for time served. It credits 1 April to 30 November (244 days, eight calendar months) as 8 months and 4 days, and February as 28 or 29 thirtieths of a month.

readings.description: The time is the difference between the last and the first day, one of them not counted.
readings.rejection_rationale: A day spent in custody is a day of the penalty served; art. 10 includes the first day.

taken.rationale: Art. 10 counts the first day and counts days, months and years on the common calendar; time in custody is time served and is counted the way a term is.

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: 1 April to 30 November 2026 credits eight months, so three years leave two years and four months (not 2 years, 3 months and 26 days)
cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: 1 to 28 February 2026 credits a month, so two years leave 23 months (not 23 months and 2 days)
cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: 1 to 28 February 2024 is 28 days and 1 to 29 February 2024 a month; 15 March to 10 May 2026 is a month and 26 days; a single day is 1 day
notes: A month is whole when the term of that many months begun on the first day, by cp-pena `o último dia do prazo`, ends on or before the last day; a period begun on the 31st therefore reads its month-ends as F-g0-02 does (31 January to 28 February 2026 is a month).

The days left over, and the sum over several periods, are a Duração at a thirtieth of a month per day, since they are subtracted from a penalty stated in months; no calendar end date is computed here.

delegated_field: Crime em julgamento.classificações (crime contra a administração pública)

site.anchor: a progressão depende da reparação do dano (art. 33, § 4º)

source.quote: § 4o O condenado por crime contra a administração pública terá a progressão de regime do cumprimento da pena condicionada à reparação do dano que causou, ou à devolução do produto do ilícito praticado, com os acréscimos legais.

readings.description: "crime contra a administração pública" is a crime of Título XI of the Parte Especial.

citations.cite: CP Parte Especial, Título XI — "Dos crimes contra a administração pública"

readings.description: Any crime that injures the public administration, wherever defined.
readings.foreclosure: The Code names a Título with the same words; a wider reading needs an authority, and none was fetched.

taken.rationale: The phrase is the heading of Título XI; the crime record carries the classification, supplied by the offence's encoder or the court.

site.anchor: o inciso I do art. 44 está satisfeito

source.quote: I – aplicada pena privativa de liberdade não superior a quatro anos e o crime não for cometido com violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa ou, qualquer que seja a pena aplicada, se o crime for culposo;

readings.description: Two alternatives: (four years or less and no violence) or (culposo, any penalty); the violence bar does not reach the culposo limb.
The violence bar governs both limbs.
readings.rejection_rationale: "qualquer que seja a pena aplicada, se o crime for culposo" is set off as its own alternative with its own condition; a culposo crime is not "cometido com violência" in the intentional sense the bar addresses.

taken.rationale: The punctuation sets the culposo limb apart.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: a culposo crime with violence and six years admits substitution

site.anchor: o crime foi cometido com violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa

source.quote: o crime não for cometido com violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa

readings.description: Violence against a person or a serious threat, as the shared means record them.
Also reducing the victim to impotence by other means (violência imprópria, as in art. 157).

citations.cite: CP art. 157, caput — "ou depois de havê-la, por qualquer meio, reduzido à impossibilidade de resistência"

readings.foreclosure: Art. 157 names that means beside violence, as a different thing; no authority settling art. 44 was fetched.

taken.rationale: Art. 157 distinguishes the two means, which suggests "violência" alone does not include the other; the narrower reading also favours the accused.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: reduction to impotence does not bar substitution
notes: M-sweep-a-39 (Súmula 588 STJ, violence or grave threat against a woman at home) is subsumed in this limb for crimes of the Code.

site.anchor: as condenações que fazem o réu reincidente em crime doloso (art. 44, II)

source.quote: II – o réu não for reincidente em crime doloso;

readings.description: Reincidente between two dolosos: the new crime is doloso and an earlier conviction generating reincidência was for a doloso.
The new crime is doloso and the agent is reincidente by any earlier crime.
readings.foreclosure: No authority fetched; the text's "em crime doloso" reads more naturally as the kind of reincidência.

readings.description: An earlier doloso conviction, whatever the new crime.
readings.rejection_rationale: A culposo new crime is substitutable "qualquer que seja a pena" (I); barring it for an earlier doloso would contradict I.

taken.rationale: "reincidente em crime doloso" names the reincidência by its kind; both crimes doloso.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: an earlier culposo conviction does not bar; a culposo new crime after an earlier doloso does not bar

site.anchor: o § 3º do art. 44 permite a substituição ao reincidente

source.quote: a reincidência não se tenha operado em virtude da prática do mesmo crime

readings.description: "o mesmo crime" is the same offence, by its article.
Crimes of the same kind (same protected interest, similar elements).
readings.foreclosure: The text says "o mesmo crime", not "crime da mesma espécie", the phrase art. 71 uses when it means the wider class.

taken.rationale: Art. 71 uses "da mesma espécie" for the wider class; § 3º's "o mesmo crime" is narrower. Compared by the conviction's `tipo penal` and the crime's.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: an earlier estelionato admits § 3º; an earlier furto against a furto does not

site.anchor: a prestação pecuniária está nos limites (art. 45, § 1º)

source.quote: não inferior a 1 (um) salário mínimo nem superior a 360 (trezentos e sessenta) salários mínimos

citations.cite: CP art. 49, § 1º — "vigente ao tempo do fato"

readings.description: The minimum wage is an input; the paragraph does not say at which date it is taken.
As art. 49, § 1º says for the dia-multa, the wage in force at the time of the fact.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 45 does not borrow art. 49's words.

readings.description: The wage in force when the judge fixes the payment.
readings.foreclosure: Not stated either.

taken.rationale: The text is silent; the caller supplies the wage, and the question is left to a lawyer.

site.anchor: as horas de tarefa (art. 46, § 3º)

source.quote: devendo ser cumpridas à razão de uma hora de tarefa por dia de condenação

readings.description: The days of the condemnation are the calendar days of the term counted from its start (art. 10): a year from 1.1.2026 is 365 hours, from 1.1.2024 366.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — "Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum."

readings.description: Thirty-day months: a year is 360 hours.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 10 counts days by the common calendar; the 30-day convention is the dosimetry's (F-g0-03), not a term's.

readings.description: 365 days a year regardless of leap years.
readings.foreclosure: A simplification the text does not make.

taken.rationale: A term served is counted on the calendar (F-g0-03); the hours follow the days.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: 365 and 366 hours for a year from 2026 and from 2024; 181 for six months from 1.1.2026

delegated_field: Crime em julgamento.agravantes que constituem ou qualificam o crime

site.anchor: as circunstâncias agravantes (arts. 61 e 62)

source.quote: Art. 61 - São circunstâncias que sempre agravam a pena, quando não constituem ou qualificam o crime:

readings.description: Which circumstances constitute or qualify the crime is the offence's own (its elements and qualificadoras); the crime record lists them and they are excluded, from art. 62 too.
The Parte Geral decides it by comparing each circumstance with the offence's definition.
readings.rejection_rationale: That needs the whole Parte Especial, which g1b may not import.

taken.rationale: The offence encoder or the court knows the elements; the list travels with the crime.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a base motive listed as the crime's qualificadora does not aggravate again
notes: Extending the exclusion to art. 62 is g1b's reading (same bis in idem); art. 62 does not say it.
F-sweep-c-08 (art. 61, II, f against art. 226, II; STJ Tema 1215, M-sweep-c-13) is the art. 226 encoder's; it bears on this list.

site.anchor: contra ascendente, descendente, irmão ou cônjuge (art. 61, II, e)

source.quote: e) contra ascendente, descendente, irmão ou cônjuge;

readings.description: "cônjuge" is the spouse by marriage; a companheiro is not included.
A companheiro in a união estável is included.
readings.foreclosure: An agravante read to reach a relation the text does not name is analogy against the accused.

taken.rationale: Penal law does not extend an aggravating circumstance by analogy; where the Code wants the companheiro it names him (e.g., art. 226, II).

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: `contra a companheira` gives no agravante

site.anchor: com abuso de autoridade, relações domésticas ou violência contra a mulher (art. 61, II, f)

source.quote: f) com abuso de autoridade ou prevalecendo-se de relações domésticas, de coabitação ou de hospitalidade, ou com violência contra a mulher na forma da lei específica;

readings.description: The relation must exist and the agent must have taken advantage of it (a finding).
The relation alone makes out the limb.
readings.rejection_rationale: "prevalecendo-se" is a participle of action: taking advantage, not merely standing in the relation.

taken.rationale: The verb is the element.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a guest who did not take advantage — no agravante

site.anchor: a exceção da violência sexual contra a mulher (art. 65, I)

source.quote: I - ser o agente menor de 21 (vinte e um) anos, na data do fato, ou maior de 70 (setenta) anos, na data da sentença, salvo se o crime envolver violência sexual contra a mulher;

readings.description: The exception reaches both the under-21 and the over-70 limbs.

citations.cite: Lei nº 15.160/2025, ementa: "vedar a redução do prazo de prescrição para os crimes que envolvam violência sexual contra a mulher, quando o agente for, na data do fato, menor de 21 (vinte e um) anos ou, na data da sentença, maior de 70 (setenta) anos de idade"

readings.description: The exception follows only the over-70 limb it sits beside.
readings.rejection_rationale: The amending law's own ementa names both ages.

taken.rationale: The amending law says so in its ementa. Only facts from 4.7.2025 (Lei 15.160, in force on publication) are reached.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: Eduardo (under 21) and Otávio (70) both lose the atenuante for a crime of 4.7.2025 involving sexual violence against a woman, and keep it for 3.7.2025

site.anchor: o novo crime é posterior ao trânsito em julgado da condenação (art. 63)

source.quote: Art. 63 - Verifica-se a reincidência quando o agente comete novo crime, depois de transitar em julgado a sentença que, no País ou no estrangeiro, o tenha condenado por crime anterior.

readings.description: The new crime on a later day than the day the conviction became final.
A crime on the day of the trânsito, after it, is reincidência.
readings.foreclosure: The record gives dates, not hours; on the day of the trânsito, "depois" cannot be shown.

taken.rationale: Dates carry no hour; in doubt the reading favourable to the accused.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a crime on 10.1.2020, the day of the trânsito, is not reincidência; on 11.1.2020 it is

site.anchor: a condenação anterior não prevalece pelo decurso de cinco anos (art. 64, I)

source.quote: I - não prevalece a condenação anterior, se entre a data do cumprimento ou extinção da pena e a infração posterior tiver decorrido período de tempo superior a 5 (cinco) anos, computado o período de prova da suspensão ou do livramento condicional, se não ocorrer revogação;

readings.description: The five years run from the start of an unrevoked probation period, else from the cumprimento or extinção; counted by art. 10, a crime on or after the fifth anniversary is after more than five years.
More than five years only from the day after the anniversary.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 10 includes the first day; by the anniversary five full years have run.

readings.description: The five years run from the cumprimento or extinção even where there was probation.
readings.rejection_rationale: "computado o período de prova" counts the probation period inside the five years.

taken.rationale: The Code's own counting rule, and the reading favourable to the accused.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: served 10.3.2015 — reincidente on 9.3.2020, not on 10.3.2020; probation from 1.1.2014 purges by 1.1.2019

site.anchor: a agravante é preponderante (art. 67)

source.quote: Art. 67 - No concurso de agravantes e atenuantes, a pena deve aproximar-se do limite indicado pelas circunstâncias preponderantes, entendendo-se como tais as que resultam dos motivos determinantes do crime, da personalidade do agente e da reincidência.

readings.description: Preponderant: the reincidência; the motives of art. 61, II, a and b, art. 62, IV and art. 65, III, a; of the personality, the age (art. 65, I) and the confession (art. 65, III, d). A multirreincidente's reincidência preponderates over a confession; one reincidência and a confession may be fully compensated.

citations.cite: STJ, Tema repetitivo 585 (thesis as reformulated by the Terceira Seção in REsp 1.931.145/SP, 22.6.2022), as quoted by the TJDFT

readings.description: Only circumstances that are literally motives or the reincidência; age and confession are not.
readings.foreclosure: Tema 585 compensates confession and reincidência as equals, which presupposes the confession preponderates.

taken.rationale: The article names three sources, not a list; the mapping is g1b's reading, with Tema 585 for the confession.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a motive against a plain atenuante — agravantes preponderate; a multirreincidente against a confession — agravantes preponderate
notes: STJ Tema 585 thesis, as quoted: "É possível, na segunda fase da dosimetria da pena, a compensação integral da atenuante da confissão espontânea com a agravante da reincidência, seja ela específica ou não. Todavia, nos casos de multirreincidência, deve ser reconhecida a preponderância da agravante prevista no art. 61, I, do Código Penal, sendo admissível a sua compensação proporcional com a atenuante da confissão espontânea". Found by g1b (WebSearch/WebFetch, 2026-09-29); sweep-a lists Tema 585 as not fetched (S-sweep-a-07).
Where both sides have a preponderant circumstance otherwise, or neither does, the Code gives no direction and the range is the whole cominated range.

site.anchor: o último dia para pagar a multa (art. 50)

source.quote: A multa deve ser paga dentro de 10 (dez) dias depois de transitada em julgado a sentença.

readings.description: Ten days beginning the day after the trânsito: the last is the tenth day after it.
Counted by art. 10 from the day of the trânsito itself: the last is the ninth day after it.
readings.rejection_rationale: "depois de transitada" starts the ten days after the trânsito.

taken.rationale: "depois de" puts the first day after the trânsito; the same day results from the procedural rule of excluding the first day.

witnesses: cp-g1b-multa-testes.l4: final on 1.9.2026, last day 11.9.2026

site.anchor: a condição do art. 54, como impressa

source.quote: Art. 54 - As penas restritivas de direitos são aplicáveis, independentemente de cominação na parte especial, em substituição à pena privativa de liberdade, fixada em quantidade inferior a 1 (um) ano, ou nos crimes culposos.

citations.cite: CP art. 44, I (redação da Lei nº 9.714/1998)

readings.description: Art. 44 (1998) governs the quantity; art. 54 (1984) keeps its "independentemente de cominação".
Substitution only below one year for dolosos, as art. 54 prints.
readings.rejection_rationale: The later law re-wrote art. 44 to reach four years; reading art. 54 as still limiting would empty that change.

taken.rationale: Lex posterior on the same subject; art. 54 was not re-worded in 1998.

witnesses: cp-g1b-cominacao-testes.l4: two years, doloso — art. 54 as printed says no, art. 44 says yes

site.anchor: as interdições aplicáveis ao crime (arts. 47, 56 e 57)

source.quote: Art. 56 - As penas de interdição, previstas nos incisos I e II do art. 47 deste Código, aplicam-se para todo o crime cometido no exercício de profissão, atividade, ofício, cargo ou função, sempre que houver violação dos deveres que lhes são inerentes.

readings.description: Interdictions I and II apply only under art. 56, III only under art. 57; IV and V (added later) have no such condition.
Arts. 56 and 57 say where the interdictions apply without excluding other cases.
readings.foreclosure: An interdiction unrelated to the crime would be a penalty without a link to the fact; the articles name the link.

taken.rationale: The articles state the link between the crime and each interdiction.

witnesses: cp-g1b-cominacao-testes.l4: a crime of no special kind gets only IV and V

site.anchor: a multa substitutiva cabe independentemente de cominação (art. 58, parágrafo único)

source.quote: Parágrafo único - A multa prevista no parágrafo único do art. 44 e no § 2º do art. 60 deste Código aplica-se independentemente de cominação na parte especial.

citations.cite: CP art. 44 (redação da Lei nº 9.714/1998), which has §§ 1º to 5º and no parágrafo único

readings.description: The dangling reference is to the substitutive fine of art. 44, § 2º.
The reference is spent and only art. 60, § 2º's fine applies independently of cominação.
readings.foreclosure: The 1984 parágrafo único of art. 44 was the substitutive fine; § 2º is where Lei nº 9.714/1998 put it.

taken.rationale: Lei nº 9.714/1998 moved the substitutive fine into § 2º and did not update the cross-reference.

notes: A drafting defect in the compiled text: a cross-reference to a paragraph that no longer exists.

delegated_field: Crime em julgamento.classificações (crime contra a dignidade sexual)

source.quote: bem como ao comportamento da vítima

readings.description: "crimes sexuais" are the crimes against sexual dignity (Título VI), a classification on the crime record; the arm governs sentences from 6.5.2024, and before it the rule refuses.
The interpretação conforme declares the only constitutional reading, so it reaches earlier sentences too.
readings.foreclosure: Whether and how the ruling reaches sentences before it is not in the quoted decision; the encoding declines rather than answer.

site.anchor: o valor do dia-multa está nos limites (arts. 49 e 60, § 1º)

source.quote: § 1º - A multa pode ser aumentada até o triplo, se o juiz considerar que, em virtude da situação econômica do réu, é ineficaz, embora aplicada no máximo.

readings.description: The value of the dia-multa may be tripled, to fifteen minimum wages.

citations.cite: CP art. 60, caput — "à situação econômica do réu"

readings.description: The whole fine, days and value, may be tripled once both are at their maximum.
readings.foreclosure: The economic situation governs the value of the day, not the number of days (art. 49); the two readings meet at the maximum.

taken.rationale: The criterion is economic, which art. 49 ties to the value of the day.

site.anchor: cabe a multa substitutiva (art. 60, § 2º)

source.quote: § 2º - A pena privativa de liberdade aplicada, não superior a 6 (seis) meses, pode ser substituída pela de multa, observados os critérios dos incisos II e III do art. 44 deste Código.

readings.description: Both stand as printed: art. 60, § 2º for up to six months under art. 44's II and III, art. 44, § 2º under all of art. 44.
Art. 44, § 2º (1998) tacitly revoked art. 60, § 2º, so violence bars the fine too.
readings.foreclosure: Nothing in the source revokes art. 60, § 2º; Lei 9.714 left it in place. No authority fetched.

site.anchor: as opções da terceira fase (art. 68, parágrafo único)

source.quote: Parágrafo único - No concurso de causas de aumento ou de diminuição previstas na parte especial, pode o juiz limitar-se a um só aumento ou a uma só diminuição, prevalecendo, todavia, a causa que mais aumente ou diminua.

readings.description: The cause that most increases or decreases is the one with the larger largest fraction, then the larger smallest; the judge may limit increases, decreases, or both.
"ou" allows limiting only increases or only decreases, not both.
readings.foreclosure: Nothing in the text excludes doing both; each limb is its own power.

taken.rationale: A range's reach is its largest fraction.

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: of a third and a half, the half is kept; of "até o dobro" and a third, the first

site.anchor: a mais grave das penas (art. 70)

source.quote: aplica-se-lhe a mais grave das penas cabíveis ou, se iguais, somente uma delas

readings.description: The penalty fixed for each crime; the reclusão is graver than the detenção, then the longer.
The longer penalty, whatever its species.
readings.foreclosure: No authority fetched; the Code ranks reclusão above detenção in arts. 33 and 69.

taken.rationale: The Code ranks the species; within one, the longer is graver.

citations.cite: CP art. 75, caput — "O tempo de cumprimento"

readings.description: Art. 75 limits the time served, so the penalty imposed is capped only by art. 70's parágrafo único.
The penalty imposed under the parágrafo único may not exceed forty years.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 75 speaks of "tempo de cumprimento"; Súmula 715 STF treats its ceiling as a limit on time served.

readings.description: The caput of art. 71 is not capped at art. 69's sum: only the parágrafo único names the cap.
The cap applies to the caput too, by analogy in favour of the accused (concurso material benéfico).

readings.description: Every concurso, the continued crime included.

site.anchor: a consequência do resultado diverso (art. 74)

source.quote: o agente responde por culpa, se o fato é previsto como crime culposo; se ocorre também o resultado pretendido, aplica-se a regra do art. 70 deste Código.

source.quote: § 2º - Sobrevindo condenação por fato posterior ao início do cumprimento da pena, far-se-á nova unificação, desprezando-se, para esse fim, o período de pena já cumprido.

source.quote: Art. 76 - No concurso de infrações, executar-se-á primeiramente a pena mais grave.

Within one species, in the order of the convictions.
readings.foreclosure: "a pena mais grave" first; the longer is graver.
